text: A hold saves a time for a family who hasn't confirmed yet. The Holds board makes sure someone follows up.
Every hold on the calendar is listed here.
The one thing to remember: a hold isn't a visit. No reminder goes out until you turn it into a real visit type, or release it.
See your holds, unassigned ones, or all of them.
Each card shows when, with whom, why, and who's following up.
Reach the family from here, and log it.
Hand it to a colleague if needed.
When the family confirms, Open / convert takes you to the hold on the calendar.
Scout shows the hold. Edit appointment, change the type to the real visit, and book it. Now it's a visit, with reminders.
If the family says no, Remove hold on the card frees the time.

The most common mistakes: leaving a hold on the calendar after the family confirms, so they get no reminder, and holds nobody follows up. Remember: a hold isn't a visit. No reminder goes out until you turn it into a real visit type, or release it.
